<thought>Using the mapped reaction for template 1914396, the product is generated from two reactants: an aromatic aldehyde bearing a sulfonamide substituent and malonic acid. Removing the atom‑mapping yields the SMILES strings for these precursors:
1. O= Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Nc2ccc(C)cc2)cc1
2. O=C(O)CC(=O)O
Thus the list of possible precursor combinations consists of this single pair.</thought>
<final_answer>[["O= Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Nc2ccc(C)cc2)cc1", "O=C(O)CC(=O)O"]]</final_answer>
